ambient_events: The hood fan changes pitch for no reason and goes back.
Fat ticks in a pan somebody left on the low ring.
The tray tower shifts a quarter inch and decides against the rest.
A timer goes off in a drawer. Nobody set it. Nobody can find it.
description: A galley kitchen wedged in behind the bar, four steps wide and hot as an argument. A six-burner range under a hood nobody has cleaned in this administration, a deep sink, a steel prep counter with one long knife scar across the middle of it, and trays stacked to the ceiling in a tower that leans and holds. Taped to the hood in a careful hand: THIS IS A KITCHEN, NOT A GREEN ROOM. OUT.
name: Jolene's — Kitchen
